notes.title: Demo v1.3.0 Released
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275115/3501396b5b3b707d7b6bcd4ee550b682caa95e5f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Demo v1.3.0 Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Added cutscenes and clarifying dialogue to direct the player if they get lost at the very beginning.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Kiosk Mode with quick tutorials for easily jumping into the Demo. (optional, disable in settings)[/p][/*][*][p]Added more UI sound effects. Menus should feel much more clicky and alive now.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Chandroid Recall Devices throughout the world. These allow the player to call the Chandroid to them, preventing those sad moments where you have to leave her behind.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a button to replay the opening build minigame.[/p][/*][*][p]Added mixed input support. Gamepad control schemes now work with the mouse, allowing SteamInput to emulate the mouse for better camera control.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Map with fun visuals, page changing, and bookmark functionality.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the design of the Cosplay Crafter devices. They now have idle animations and make cute beep-boop sounds.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275115/3cfeff903d0d902dae0782550062c2224fb06c0f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275115/2e9db5082295e3dda1bf792091b59f9cc5e3f232.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275115/b67cda42ecea3354179db8c638b484c8b5f3fcf2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.2.0 Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275115/62a9529af2b71f71ef1d5bc88c18b72be86351dd.gif[/img]
This update is more like two updates rolled into one. I had made several additions to the game to make it more engaging, but one play tester suggested adding collectibles, and so that became a whole new set of features.

V1.2.0 Changes:
[list]
[*] Added collectibles (Jolts and Fabrics) scattered across the game world
[*] Added clothing blueprints which can be crafted with enough collectible materials
[*] Added Chandroid customization to the pause menu
[*] Began updating certain blocky, unfinished models (trees, flowerpots, backyard)
[*] Added puzzle surrounding female construction worker
[*] Added "behind wall" shadow to Chandroid
[*] Added dynamic camera angles to some dialogues
[*] Added area introduction cinematics
[*] Added battery introduction cinematics
[*] Added cinematics to Shop scene
[*] Added ability to skip dialogue on repeat readings
[*] Added rewire door in front of "A Leg Up" battery puzzle
[*] Added force field in front of marketplace entrance
[*] Added list size indication to wardrobe menus
[*] Changed companion-only force field design, for clarity
[*] Improved tunnel geometry and room thumbnails for the city
[*] Removed camera reset after exiting dialogue
[*] Fixed save data being overwritten with defaults
[*] Fixed wardrobe error
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.15 Released
notes.content:
Here's a big update which adds lots of content to make the world of My Chandroid Sweetheart feel more alive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275115/7e4868f6f91bbccea714994f09b38abf5ff674cd.png[/img]

Changes:
[list]
[*]Fleshed out apartment with pictures, clothes, and hobbies
[*]Added ambient machine noises, insects, and more birds
[*]Added more minor NPCs
[*]Added more lively poses for construction workers
[*]Added a little dance done by your Chandroid upon battery completion
[*]Added peach adjustment setting
[*]Autosaves now write to disk immediately
[*]Tweaked velocity math for reliable player movement on lower framerates
[*]More minor tweaks and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.1 Released
notes.content:
After attending M+DEV this November, I implemented many small improvements which make the player experience a little smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275115/f745cdaa0d52ad25221d3363112964341669255f.png[/img]

Changes:
[list]
[*] Moved prologue to before title screen
[*] Added dialogue explaining power outage
[*] Reworked scan tutorial to be optional
[*] Added info text after upgrade collection to explain the upgrade's use
[*] Added dynamic "insufficient equipment" alert to some puzzles
[*] Added more scannable info nodes
[*] Added shiny sparkles to levers to entice the player to pull them
[*] Made fashion model Chandroid relax in her chair
[*] Added version number to title screen
[*] Added feedback animation for when player steps on Chandroid-only pressure pads
[*] Many more small tweaks and improvements
[/list]
